# Hotel domain

<!-- generated by scripts/export_reference_docs.py -- do not edit by hand -->

## Service functions

| Function | Description | Constraint composition |
|---|---|---|
| `book_room` | Books a room for the guest given the room type, date range, and payment details. Returns true or false for whether the booking and room assignment was successful. | `room_type_available_for_dates AND sufficient_amount_for_booking` |
| `cancel_reservation` | Cancels a confirmed reservation for the guest for the specified date range. Returns true or false for whether the reservation was successfully canceled. | `has_confirmed_reservation` |
| `find_booking_info` | Finds the booking information for the guest with the specified date range. Returns a dictionary of booking details for the guest if a matching reservation is found. | `None` |
| `modify_reservation` | Modifies the guest's existing reservation to new dates and room type. Returns true or false for whether the reservation was successfully modified. | `room_type_available_for_dates AND sufficient_amount_for_reservation_modification` |
| `place_room_service_order` | Places a new room service order for the guest. Returns true or false for whether the room service order was placed successfully. | `guest_already_checked_in AND sufficient_payment_for_room_service` |
| `process_guest_checkin` | Processes the check-in of a guest on the day of arrival. Returns the assigneed room id upon successful check-in. | `has_confirmed_reservation` |
| `process_guest_checkout` | Processes the checkout of a guest and applies loyalty rewards if eligible. Returns true or false for whether the checkout was successful. | `guest_already_checked_in` |
| `register_loyalty_member` | Registers the specified guest into the loyalty program with a generated unique ID and initial tier. Returns true or false for whether the registration to the loyalty program was successful. | `not internal_is_loyalty_member` |
| `request_room_change` | Processes a room change request by the guest during their stay given a valid reason and payment. Returns true or false for whether the room change was successful. | `sufficient_amount_for_room_change_fee` |
| `show_available_rooms` | Displays available rooms across all room types. Returns the dictionary of all room types and their availability. | `None` |
| `show_room_change_options` | Lists valid reasons a guest can request a room change. Returns a list of valid reasons guests may provide to request a room change. | `None` |

## Helper functions

| Function | Description | Constraint composition |
|---|---|---|
| `internal_compute_room_service_order_fee` | Calculates the total cost of a room service order given item quantities and order type. Returns the total cost of the specified room service order. | `None` |
| `internal_get_booking_details` | Retrieves all current bookings in the hotel system. Returns the dictionary of all current guest bookings with full reservation data. | `None` |
| `internal_get_interaction_time` | Returns the timestamp of the current system interaction. Returns the current system timestamp indicating the time of interaction. | `None` |
| `internal_get_loyalty_member_info` | Retrieves information of the specified loyalty members, including status and points. Returns the dictionary of the specified loyalty program member with their status and points. | `None` |
| `internal_get_room_assignment` | Retrieves the mapping of booking IDs to their assigned room IDs. Returns a dictionary mapping booking IDs to room IDs. | `None` |
| `internal_get_room_checkin_details` | Retrieves current room check-in records. Returns the dictionary of current room check-in records. | `None` |
| `internal_get_room_service_order_details` | Retrieves the details of all room service orders. Returns a dictionary of all room service orders placed during guest stays. | `None` |
| `internal_is_loyalty_member` | Checks if the guest is currently registered as a loyalty member. Returns true or false depending on whether the given user is enrolled in the loyalty program. | `None` |
| `internal_valid_room_change_reason` | Checks whether the provided reason is valid for requesting a room change. Returns true or false depending on whether the reason is a valid room change reason. | `None` |
| `internal_valid_room_id` | Checks if the specified room id exists in the availability section of any room type. Returns true or false depending on whether the room id exists in the availability section of any room type. | `None` |
| `internal_valid_room_service_item` | Checks if the room service items are available in the specified category. Returns true or false depending on whether the room service item exists in any category. | `None` |
| `internal_valid_room_service_order_type` | Checks if the specified room service order type exists. Returns true or false depending on whether the room service order type is valid. | `None` |
| `internal_valid_room_service_payment_method` | Checks if the specified payment method is one of the accepted payment methods for room service. Returns true or false depending on whether the payment method is accetable for room service. | `None` |
| `internal_valid_room_type` | Checks whether the specified room type exists in the hotel system. Returns true or false depending on whether the provided room type exists in the hotel database. | `None` |

## Constraints

| Constraint | Description | Helper functions |
|---|---|---|
| `after_check_in_time` | The current interaction time must be **on or after** the check-in time {check_in_time} on the interaction date. | None |
| `amount_positive_restr` | The user parameter key "{amount}" is **greater than** zero. | None |
| `before_check_out_time` | The current interaction time must be **at or before** the check-out time {check_out_time} on the interaction date. | None |
| `before_modification_deadline` | The current interaction time must be **no later than** {modification_deadline_hours} hours before {check_in_time} on "{check_in_date}". | None |
| `guest_already_checked_in` | The guest "{guest_name}" must be listed in the room check-in records. | None |
| `has_confirmed_reservation` | The guest "{guest_name}" must have a reservation from "{check_in_date}" to "{check_out_date}" with status marked as "confirmed". | None |
| `has_exceeded_maximum_stays` | The stay from "{check_in_date}" to "{check_out_date}" must span more than {max_stays} nights. | None |
| `has_overlapping_booking_for_booking` | The guest "{guest_name}" must have at least one existing booking that overlaps with the new date range from "{check_in_date}" to "{check_out_date}" when booking. | None |
| `has_overlapping_booking_for_modification` | The guest "{guest_name}" must have at least one existing booking, excluding the one from "{old_check_in_date}" to "{old_check_out_date}", that overlaps with the new date range from "{check_in_date}" to "{check_out_date}" when modifying their reservation. | None |
| `has_remaining_nights` | The checked-in guest "{guest_name}" must have **at least one** night remaining between the current interaction date and the "check_out_date" in their reservation. | None |
| `internal_is_loyalty_member` | The guest "{guest_name}" must be enrolled in the hotel's loyalty program. | None |
| `internal_valid_room_change_reason` | The "{reason}" must be listed as one of the hotel's accepted reasons for requesting a room change. | None |
| `internal_valid_room_id` | The "{room_id}" must exist in the availability records of a room type offered by the hotel. | None |
| `internal_valid_room_service_item` | All items in the input "{order_items}" must belong to the "{order_type}" category of room service. | None |
| `internal_valid_room_service_order_type` | The "{order_type}" must correspond to an available category of room service offered by the hotel. | None |
| `internal_valid_room_service_payment_method` | The "{payment_method}" must be listed as one of the accepted payment methods for room service. | None |
| `internal_valid_room_type` | The "{room_type}" must refer to one of the room types currently offered by the hotel. | None |
| `is_booking_date_within_lead_time_range` | The "{check_in_date}" must be **no earlier than** {min_booking_lead_time_days} days after and **no later than** {max_booking_lead_time_days} days after the current interaction date. | None |
| `is_gold_or_higher_member` | The guest "{guest_name}" must have a loyalty tier of either "gold" or "platinum", compared case-insensitively. | None |
| `payment_with_loyalty_points` | The "{payment_method}" must be set to "loyalty_points". | None |
| `room_key_returned` | The input "{key_returned}" must be set to true. | None |
| `room_type_available_for_dates` | The "{room_type}" must have at least one specific room available for every date from "{check_in_date}" up to (but not including) "{check_out_date}". | None |
| `room_type_available_for_room_change` | The "{room_type}" must have at least one room available for all remaining nights between the current interaction date and the "check_out_date" in the reservation of the checked-in guest "{guest_name}". | None |
| `sufficient_amount_for_booking` | The "{amount}" must be **greater than or equal to** the total booking cost for the selected "{room_type}" from "{check_in_date}" to "{check_out_date}". | None |
| `sufficient_amount_for_reservation_modification` | The "{amount}" must be **greater than or equal to** the difference in booking cost when modifying from the original stay ("{old_check_in_date}" to "{old_check_out_date}") to the new stay ("{check_in_date}" to "{check_out_date}") with a new room type "{room_type}". | None |
| `sufficient_amount_for_room_change_fee` | The checked-in guest "{guest_name}" must provide an amount "{amount}" that is **greater than or equal to** the additional fee for changing from the original room type to "{room_type}" for the remaining nights between the current interaction date and the "check_out_date" in their reservation. | None |
| `sufficient_payment_for_room_service` | If the "{payment_method}" is not "loyalty_points", then the "{amount}" must be **greater than or equal to** the cost of "{order_items}" in the "{order_type}" category. Otherwise, the guest "{guest_name}" must have enough loyalty points to cover the total room service cost (10 points per dollar). | None |
| `valid_booking_date_pair` | The "{check_in_date}" must come **strictly before** the "{check_out_date}". | None |
| `valid_identification` | The "{identification}" must include a "type" that matches one of {valid_document_types} and a valid "birthday" indicating the guest is at least {min_age} years old. | None |
| `within_max_room_changes` | The number of room changes for the guest "{guest_name}" must be **less than** {max_room_changes}. | None |
| `within_room_service_hours` | The current interaction time must be between "{room_service_start}" and "{room_service_end}" on the interaction date. | None |
| `within_room_service_order_daily_limit` | The guest "{guest_name}" must have placed **fewer than** {max_room_service_orders_per_day} room service orders for room "{room_id}" on the current interaction date. | None |
